criteria.description: AI/ML command/result events use the phase-1 38390-38399 namespace and avoid NIP-90 reserved 5000-7000 ranges.
AI/ML read models use 31980-31989 addressable/replaceable events with stable d-tag coordinates.
Every long-running import, recipe, deployment, rollback, and evaluation flow returns Nostr correlation metadata and completes through status/result events rather than HTTP polling.
Command/result events include e, p, status, and relevant scoped tags such as model, version, recipe, run, endpoint, environment, deployment, artifact, worker, and runtime.
Existing LLM 597x/697x/797x/3196x compatibility semantics remain stable and are not mutated into generic AI semantics.

coverage_notes: Criteria are mapped from the AI/ML inference fabric plan and are placeholders pending implementation tests.
